items.stem: Which of the following is a core technique of biotechnology that involves altering the chemistry of genetic material?

What is the main purpose of using restriction enzymes in recombinant DNA technology?
What is the main purpose of using bioreactors in biotechnology?
What is the name of the sequence in DNA that allows replication of an alien piece of DNA?

What is the term used for a protein produced by a gene that has been inserted into a host organism?
